g.text: GENERAL TOLERANCES ISO 2768-mK. DO NOT SCALE.
CONCEPT DESIGN. FICTIONAL SYSTEM. ALL DIMENSIONS FROM THE MODEL AS MEASURED.
PROPORTIONS AND MOUNT GEOMETRY FROZEN AT GATE G1
DETAILED MODEL, SEVENTEEN ASSEMBLIES, GATE G2
KNEE ANCHORS, ANKLE PADS, LOOMS REVISED. DRAWING SET ISSUED
ON THE CENTRE PLANE, LOOKING TO THE RIGHT-HAND SIDE
1. ASSEMBLY 01 HEAD AND CAP: 70 PARTS, 1.35 kg. ASSEMBLY 02 NECK: 27 PARTS, 0.73 kg.
2. THE CAP IS WORN BRIM TO THE REAR. THE FRONT VIEW LOOKS INTO THE STRAP ARCH.
3. SECTION A-A IS TAKEN ON THE CENTRE PLANE. FASTENERS, GLASS AND MESH ARE NOT LINED.
4. THE PARTS LIST NAMES THE BALLOONED ITEMS ONLY.
